description: Operator telemetry of the hosted service (not your own usage); needs the operator key (header x-motionspec-key). This unauthenticated call returns access information only; it does not compile code, fetch URLs, run an audit or read usage data. Arguments are optional and unused. Returns isError:true with structuredContent {ok:false, error:'KEY_REQUIRED', tool, freeLocalAlternative} and text guidance. For your own local activity use 'npx -p motionspec motion stats' (MIT). It reads this machine's local activity, not hosted usage.
name: motion_stats
title: MotionSpec usage telemetry
